label: preparing
what: An evening community hospitality gathering in the hall, with fresh bread/feast loaves and lanterns; the mayor was not told the occasion/details until it was announced and invited for 18:00. The baker, freight, and secretary knowingly assisted or relayed preparations; the baker supplied loaves, freight helped coordinate catering/invitation information, and secretary arranged the mayor's visit. Neighbour's participation is supported by invitation-spreading, though the evidence for operational preparation is weaker than for the core participants.
